newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Uralmash plans ADRs at end of 1997 or 1998.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Uralmash plans ADRs at end of 1997 or 1998.

text.p: Russian heavy equipment maker AO Uralmash plans to issue American Depositary Receipts by the end of the year or early next year, company president Kakha Bendukidze said Friday.

He said OAO Uralsky Zavod Tyazhelogo Mashinostroyeniya (Uralmash) would make a private placement of between $30 million and $35 million of new shares that would then be transformed to ADRs, shares that can trade in the United States.
Uralmash, located near Yekaterinburg in the Ural mountains, produces metallurgical, mining, drilling and other heavy equipment.
